title: Installation fails on Windows with missing dependency
body: The setup guide does not mention the required dependency and installation fails on Windows.

title: Setup documentation is confusing for beginners
body: I cannot configure the application using the current tutorial. A working example would help.

title: API integration times out on large imports
body: The import API is slow and requests timeout with large data files.

title: Login fails after upgrade
body: After upgrade, authentication fails and users cannot access the dashboard.

title: Import documentation lacks examples
body: The import guide should include examples for CSV files.

title: Dashboard loads slowly
body: The UI performance is slow when the dashboard loads lots of data.
